name: Two Moons Rising
overview: From the world of Life is Strange, Two Moons Rising is the offical FREE downloadable Tabletop Murder Mystery that puts you into the shoes of a collection of misfit teenagers that find themselves at a youth empowerment camp where things go horribly wrong, leaving an isolated boy dead and suspects around every corner.  It's up to you and your friends to unravel the strange occurances that led to the murder and overcome your past mistakes as two moons rise and nothing is left in the shadows.
